description: Run GeoGebra commands on the live figure, in order (English command names, e.g. "A = (-1, 6)", "M = Midpoint(B, C)", "ShowLabel(a, false)", "SetVisibleInView(h, 1, false)", "Delete(P)"). Assigning to an existing name REDEFINES that object and its dependents update. Returns, per command: ok, created/removed objects, warnings (undefined objects, names not created) and, for failures, hints about the likely cause.

commands.description: Commands to run, one per item, in execution order

stop_on_error.description: Stop at the first failed command (later commands usually depend on it). Default true.

name: ggb_run_commands
title: Run GeoGebra commands
